news.title: Man threatens to kill grandmother, self, spits on officer after family fight
news.summary: A Cobb County man is in jail after being accused of assaulting two women and spitting on a police officer.

news.title: Woman says musician slapped her during concert, police report filed
news.summary: A woman says she was slapped by a musician during a concert in Tucker earlier this month, an alleged confrontation captured on cellphone video that is now the subject of a police report.

news.title: Death investigation at apartments behind popular food hall
news.summary: A body was found along Chattahoochee Avenue on Tuesday morning.

news.title: Truck driver ran red light before deadly Snellville crash, police say
news.summary: One person is dead after a car wreck in Gwinnett County on Monday.

news.title: GBI joins death investigation in northwest Atlanta
news.summary: State agents joined an Atlanta death investigation on Chattahoochee Avenue NW Tuesday following a request from local authorities.

news.title: 1 of 3 men reported missing in metro Atlanta area still missing
news.summary: Authorities asked for the public’s help Monday night in locating three men reported missing in separate metro Atlanta cases.

news.title: Red light crash in Snellville leaves 1 dead, 1 hospitalized
news.summary: A fatal two-vehicle collision shut down a Snellville intersection Monday morning after a pickup truck ran a red light and slammed into a sedan, according to police.

news.title: Ex-East Point officer sentenced to life after sex assault conviction
news.summary: A former East Point police sergeant convicted of sexually assaulting vulnerable women and a teenager while on duty learned his sentence Tuesday.

news.summary: Richard Gooddine was convicted at trial earlier this month on five sex crimes counts.
